bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the Nursing in Australia Salary

When researching a **nursing in australia salary**, the most reliable figures come from the Fair Work Ombudsman’s Nurses Award 2020. This award sets minimum pay rates for nurses and assistants across classifications, from nursing assistants to registered nurses at Level 4. The rates are updated each year following the Annual Wage Review.

### How Annual Pay Is Calculated

To convert an hourly rate to an annual salary, use the formula:

**Annual gross ≈ hourly rate × hours per week × 52**

For full-time employees under the Nurses Award, ordinary hours are 38 per week (or an average of 38). So a full-time nurse earning $32.09 per hour would have an annual gross of approximately $32.09 × 38 × 52 = $63,410. This assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, and no allowances. The fortnightly pay would be weekly pay × 2: $1,219.50 × 2 = $2,439.

### Nursing Award Rates (Full-Time and Part-Time)

The [pay guides](/blog) from the Fair Work Ombudsman list minimum rates for each classification. For example, from 1 August 2026:

- Registered Nurse Level 1, pay point 1: $32.09 per hour, $1,219.50 per week
- Registered Nurse Level 1, pay point 8: $38.57 per hour, $1,465.50 per week
- Registered Nurse Level 2, pay point 1: $39.59 per hour, $1,504.40 per week
- Enrolled Nurse pay point 1: $30.00 per hour, $1,139.90 per week
- Nursing assistant (Certificate III): $29.45 per hour, $1,119.10 per week

These are the base rates for full-time and part-time employees. Part-time employees are paid pro-rata based on 38 hours per week.

### Casual Loading and Super Paid on Top

Casual employees under the Nurses Award receive a 25% loading on the minimum hourly rate. This is in addition to the base rate. For example, a casual RN Level 1 pay point 1 would earn $32.09 × 1.25 = $40.11 per hour. The casual loading compensates for entitlements such as paid sick leave and annual leave.

Superannuation is paid **on top** of the base rate (ordinary time earnings), not the casual-loaded rate. The Super Guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. For a full-time RN Level 1 pay point 1, that adds about $3.85 per hour to the total cost of employment. You can explore more about [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) on our site.

### Distinguishing Award Rates from the National Minimum Wage

The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. Casual employees under the National Minimum Wage receive $33.05 per hour including the 25% loading. However, nursing award rates are higher than the minimum wage. For example, even the lowest nursing assistant rate ($27.65 per hour) exceeds the minimum. Always check the specific award classification for your role.

### Tax and Medicare

Using the 2026–27 resident tax rates:
- Nil tax on the first $18,200
- 15% on income from $18,201 to $45,000
- 30% on income from $45,001 to $135,000
- 37% on income from $135,001 to $190,000
- 45% on income above $190,000

Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income. For a nurse earning $63,410, the estimated tax would be approximately $10,700 plus Medicare $1,268, leaving about $51,442 after tax. This is a rough estimate; use our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) tool for a more detailed calculation.

### Using the Timesheet

Our [timesheet](/) lets you enter a base hourly rate and optionally add the 25% casual loading. It then calculates annual, fortnightly, and weekly pay, along with estimated tax and super. For nursing, enter the base award rate (e.g., $32.09) and check the casual loading box if applicable. Do not enter a rate that already includes casual loading.

### Summary

A **nursing in australia salary** is best understood through the Nurses Award minimum rates. Full-time nurses work 38 hours per week, and casuals receive a 25% loading. Super is paid on top of the base rate. Always refer to the Fair Work Ombudsman’s official [reference tables](/data) for the most current figures. For individual calculations, use our [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) tool.
